XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='CernLabMicroBb:Cern_LabMicroBb' targetDocType='CernLabMicroBb:Cern_LabMicroBb' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>Transforms iCentra Results into Nirvana results</annotation> <trace value='"#### DTL:BEGIN ####"' /> <assign value='source.{PIDgrpgrp(1).ORCgrp(1).OBR:DiagnosticServSectID}' property='obr24' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <if condition='(obr24 ="MA") || (obr24 ="MB")' > <true> <assign value='"3MMICLAB"' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <assign value='"3MLAB"' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> </false> </if> <assign value='source.{PIDgrpgrp()}' property='target.{PIDgrpgrp()}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.Pid8' property='target.{PIDgrpgrp(1).PIDgrp.PID:Sex}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PIDgrpgrp().ORCgrp()}' property='target.{PIDgrpgrp().ORCgrp()}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PIDgrpgrp().ORCgrp().OBXgrp()}' property='target.{PIDgrpgrp().ORCgrp().OBXgrp()}' action='set' /> <foreach property='target.{PIDgrpgrp(1).ORCgrp()}' key='k1' > <assign value='context.Obr25.GetAt(k1)' property='target.{PIDgrpgrp(1).ORCgrp(k1).OBR:ResultStatus}' action='set' /> <foreach property='target.{PIDgrpgrp(1).ORCgrp(k1).OBXgrp()}' key='k2' > <assign value='context.Obx8.GetAt(k1_"-"_k2)' property='target.{PIDgrpgrp(1).ORCgrp(k1).OBXgrp(k2).OBX:AbnormalFlags(1)}' action='set' /> <assign value='context.Obx11.GetAt(k1_"-"_k2)' property='target.{PIDgrpgrp(1).ORCgrp(k1).OBXgrp(k2).OBX:ObservationResultStatus}' action='set' /> </foreach> </foreach> <trace value='"#### DTL:END ####"' /> </transform>
